description:
Private transfer options to add to a Camino de Santiago package
        (e.g. Santiago airport or city → Sarria before the first stage, or back
        from the last town): one option per vehicle type with enough seats,
        with distance, duration and how much it ADDS to the package total
        (`variacion_total_eur`). Town ids come from camino_route_towns. To
        include one, re-quote with quote_camino_package(traslados=[{
        origen_poblacion_id, destino_poblacion_id, fecha, categoria_id}]).
        / Opciones de traslado privado para añadir al paquete del Camino, con
        lo que suma cada una al total. Para incluirla, recotiza con
        `traslados`. (es: opciones_traslado)
name: camino_transfer_options
title: Private transfer options for a Camino package
